subject: Request: Forrester Case Study — Holloway Ops deployment & performance metrics
messages:
From: Claire Chen <claire.chen@forrester.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@holloway-ops.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@holloway-ops.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forrester case study opportunity — Holloway Ops

Hi Logan and Tom,

Im reaching out from Forrester Research. Were preparing a short customer case study on organizations that have reduced inference cost by >30% while keeping response latency under 200ms. Holloway Ops was recommended by our engineering research team based on the pilot results you shared in March.

Would Holloway Ops be willing to participate in a short write-up (Forrester editorial, non-promotional) and a 30-minute interview with our analyst? We will need:
- A 30-minute interview with a technical lead (preferably the person who ran the pilot)
- A handful of performance metrics (latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens)
- Permission to use logo and short quotations

If yes, we can send a simple NDA/consent form and proposed questions. Proposed windows next week: Tue/Wed 10:00-13:00 PT.

Thanks,
Claire Chen
Principal Analyst, AI Infrastructure
Forrester Research
claire.chen@forrester.com

----
Attachment: Forrester-case-study-brief.pdf (PDF)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire.chen@forrester.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@holloway-ops.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester case study opportunity — Holloway Ops

Claire, thanks for the note and for flagging Holloway. Tom: really appreciate you being open to this.

Holloway ran a pilot with our Dedicated offering in March; their infra + batching changes are exactly the type of story Forrester highlights. Wed be happy to coordinate.

Tom, quick questions to help smooth the process:
- Who should Claire speak with for the technical interview (name, title, best contact)?
- Any internal approval process / legal review we should expect for a quote/logo?
- Are the pilot metrics still shareable at the granularity asked? If not, we can provide redacted aggregates.

Im looping in Laura from our Advocacy/Legal ops team to help with the NDA and collection of artifacts (screenshots, perf report). Laura  CCed.

Next steps I can take: send a short-case-study outline, draft NDA for signature, and propose two interview windows that match Claires times. 

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

----
Attachment: Holloway-case-study-outline.pdf (PDF)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@holloway-ops.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Claire Chen <claire.chen@forrester.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@holloway-ops.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forrester case study opportunity — Holloway Ops

Logan/Claire, thanks for including me. I can be the technical contact for the interview; title is Head of ML Ops. My calendar is open Weds 21 10-12 PT or Thurs 22 11-12 PT.

Regarding approvals: our legal team needs to sign a standard consent/NDA before we share any internal metrics or screenshots. Ive added Legal on copy. Im fine with aggregated metrics being used publicly and a short quote from me.

Laura, can you send the NDA to legal@holloway-ops.com? If possible, include a short summary of what metrics will be requested so legal can pre-clear.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of ML Ops, Holloway Ops
+1 (206) 555-4420

----

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Legal <legal@holloway-ops.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@holloway-ops.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Claire Chen <claire.chen@forrester.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Forrester case study opportunity — Holloway Ops

Hi Tom and team,

Thanks  looping legal in. Ive uploaded a short consent template and a draft NDA for Forrester to the DocuSign link below; these are the usual items we send for analyst references. The consent template includes the metric list: median 95th-pct latency, average cost per 1M tokens, peak QPS during pilot, and a short description of batching/quantization changes. If you need narrower sharing (redacted or percent-improvement only) we can adjust.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/example-signature
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HD-9981

Attached: NDA-Forrester-signed.pdf (we ask Forrester to sign first so legal can confirm). Once you confirm the DocuSign, Ill pull the performance artifacts and a redacted dashboard screenshot for Claire. Proposed interview: Wed 21 Apr at 10:30 PT. Please confirm and Ill calendar-in the call and send a brief agenda.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Customer Advocacy & Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

----
Attachments: NDA-Forrester-signed.pdf, Holloway-case-study-outline.pdf
